stage: Exploratory second revision on 2026-10-06; frozen before this analysis run, not pre-registered
cost_assignment: equal=1; bounded_variable=1+(first 8 hex SHA256(reference_id) modulo 5); independent of labels
heterogeneous_recovery_sensitivity: bounded_variable costs; probability from [1,.8,.5] indexed by next 8 hex SHA256(reference_id) modulo 3; both strategies
strategies: width_per_cost for uniform p; both width_per_cost and expected_width_per_cost for heterogeneous p
capacity_budget: floor(fraction * sum(all hidden unique-reference costs)); planner may skip unaffordable indivisible items
figure_grid: integer cost budgets 0..400, actual greedy affordability scan at every budget, same selection rule as API; vectorised over budgets and checked against API
target_cost_definition: first crossing along complete label-free priority order (ordered prefix); not minimum knapsack cost; not expectation of random stopping cost
error_scope: all currently observed unique labels in the controlled population, including initially retained and subsequently returned labels; original observations are not assumed physically validated
error_evaluation: ideal p=1 equal and variable costs only; exact at-most-r label-flip bounds at each prefix
interpretation: One Permian archive case plus structural synthetic validation; no second empirical environment, actual costs, field recovery probabilities, flight savings, or adaptive policy effects
